 About American Express
 
 
 
 

 
 
 Don't live life without it. Don't do business without it. American Express is a global service company, providing customers with exceptional access to products, insights and experiences that enrich lives and build business success. Each day, American Express makes it easier, safer and more rewarding for consumers and businesses to purchase the things they need and for merchants to sell their goods and services. An engine of commerce, American Express provides innovative payment, travel and expense management solutions for individuals and businesses of all sizes. Most of all, we help our customers realize their dreams and aspirations through industry-leading benefits, access to unique experiences, business-building insights, and global customer care. We enable our customers to do and achieve more.

 The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Backend Engineering and Feature Ownership: You independently design, build, and ship complete backend features from low-level data models and APIs to production deployment.You take full ownership of your deliverables, ensuring correctness, performance, and reliability under real-world load.System Design and Architecture: You own Statement of Work (SoW) adherence, tracking milestones and deliverables for all vendor agreements.You manage change requests and ensure vendor accountability through structured governance.Code Quality and Engineering Standards: You write clean, well-tested, and maintainable code that upholds the team's engineering standards.You actively participate in code reviews, giving and receiving feedback o continuously raise the quality bar.Performance and Reliability: You identify and resolve performance bottlenecks through query optimisation, caching strategies, and efficient API design.You contribute to incident response, post-mortems, and preventive improvements to keep systems stable and fast.Mentorship and Cross-team Collaboration: You guide and upskill SDE 1 engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and design walkthroughs.You collaborate effectively with product managers, frontend engineers, and QA to deliver cohesive, well-tested features.Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.4-6+ years of hands-on backend software engineering experience in a product-based company or fast-growing startup.Strong proficiency in at least one backend language Java, Python, Go, or Node.js and comfort working across the stack when needed.Some experience in Python is required.Solid understanding of system design principles: RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and database design.Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases; ability to write and optimise complex queries.Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.Proven ability to own features end-to-end, work independently, and mentor junior engineers.Strong problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to handle ambiguity and deliver in a fast-paced environment.
